parsed_json.up: Select compounds tested against human CB1 cannabinoid receptor (CHEMBL218) with IC50 values in nM. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary filtering by target ChEMBL ID and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Left join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key. Left join docs on activities.doc_id to derive pubmed_id_or_doi preferring pubmed_id over doi. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
